code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (notably low neutrophils and lymphocytes, elevated monocytes and basophils). There is mild hypoalbuminemia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, and INR, with slightly increased alkaline phosphatase. These findings suggest systemic inflammation, possible infection or hematologic disorder, and risk for coagulopathy. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
